summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Trinity IT support system UI redesign with white/black theme and escalation level functionality. Backend APIs working excellently (88.9% success rate), but identified critical UI interaction issue with L1/L2/L3 folder navigation.

minor_bugs.impact: Dashboard statistics not available, but core functionality unaffected

ui_bugs.issue: Escalation folders display counts correctly but are not clickable - buttons exist but click events fail

integration_issues.issue: L1/L2/L3 folders show correct counts (286, 3, 3) but navigation to filtered views doesn't work

passed_tests: Escalation counts API returning correct data: L1=286, L2=3, L3=3
Backend ticket filtering by escalation level working (L1, L2, L3)
Light theme successfully applied and active
Sidebar rendering with escalation section visible
Ticket list displaying 50+ tickets with L1/L2/L3 badges
3-panel ticket drawer fully functional (customer history, conversation, details)
All basic navigation (Dashboard, All Tickets) working
action_item_for_main_agent: Critical: Fix L1/L2/L3 escalation folder click functionality. The folders are visible with correct counts but the button click events are not working. This breaks the core feature requirement for escalation level navigation. Check button event handlers and data-testid attributes in Sidebar.js escalation folder implementation.
